target_scope: GBP_JPY only; trigger and pair gate unchanged
runner: app.run_daytrade_backtest(backtest_mode=True; production daytrade path; strategy-only compute patch)

lock_spec.bt_evidence_threshold: if proposed N < 20 => INSUFFICIENT_BT_EVIDENCE, skip catastrophic, recommend shadow

shadow_registration_note: base rsk_gbpjpy_reversion is already in DaytradeEngine.SHADOW_ALWAYS_STRATEGIES; V2 live/shadow behavior remains default-off unless RSK_GBPJPY_REVERSION_REDESIGN_V2=1
shadow_accumulation_target: 60-90 days or N>=30 after shadow start

self_review.catastrophic_only: PASS: verdict ignores positive-direction and Kelly; applies only v2 catastrophic/floor rules when N>=20.
self_review.insufficient_bt_evidence: PASS: proposed N<20 becomes INSUFFICIENT_BT_EVIDENCE and shadow recommendation.
self_review.production_live_safety: PASS: strategy V2 geometry is default-off unless RSK_GBPJPY_REVERSION_REDESIGN_V2=1; app BT cache and SL/TP preserve are flag-aware.
self_review.post_hoc_adjustment: PASS: only the pre-registered MR exit geometry variant is evaluated.
self_review.bt_source_guard: PASS: BT_REQUIRE_MASSIVE_CACHE=1 reads the MASSIVE parquet cache and prevents Yahoo fallback for this report.
